package http3

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"

	"github.com/quic-go/quic-go"
	"github.com/quic-go/quic-go/quicvarint"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// Replaces the upstream TestParserUnsupportedFrameTypes, which required push
// frames to be skipped. They are returned so that callers can reject them
// (RFC 9114 sections 7.2.3, 7.2.5 and 7.2.7).
func TestRelayParserPushFrames(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		typ  uint64
		want frame
	}{
		{0x3, &cancelPushFrame{PushID: 7}},
		{0xd, &maxPushIDFrame{PushID: 7}},
	} {
		data := quicvarint.Append(quicvarint.Append(quicvarint.Append(nil, tc.typ), 1), 7)
		fp := frameParser{r: bytes.NewReader(data)}
		f, err := fp.ParseNext(nil)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, tc.want, f)

		// A push ID that does not fill the frame payload is malformed.
		data = append(quicvarint.Append(quicvarint.Append(quicvarint.Append(nil, tc.typ), 2), 7), 0)
		fp = frameParser{r: bytes.NewReader(data)}
		_, err = fp.ParseNext(nil)
		require.Error(t, err)
	}

	promise := append(quicvarint.Append(quicvarint.Append(nil, 0x5), 6), []byte("foobar")...)
	promise = (&dataFrame{Length: 3}).Append(promise)
	r := bytes.NewReader(promise)
	fp := frameParser{r: r}
	f, err := fp.ParseNext(nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.IsType(t, &pushPromiseFrame{}, f)
	f, err = fp.ParseNext(nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, &dataFrame{Length: 3}, f)

	// A client never sends MAX_PUSH_ID, so any PUSH_PROMISE on its request
	// streams is H3_ID_ERROR (section 7.2.5).
	var code quic.ApplicationErrorCode
	fp = frameParser{
		client:    true,
		r:         bytes.NewReader(promise),
		closeConn: func(c quic.ApplicationErrorCode, _ string) error { code = c; return nil },
	}
	_, err = fp.ParseNext(nil)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, quic.ApplicationErrorCode(ErrCodeIDError), code)
}
